Layer 3 · City

Twelve markets, one comparison

These are the cities where foreigners actually buy. Each one is assessed on the same seven dimensions, so a comparison between two of them means something — and so that a city can be ruled out for a reason better than "I liked it there".

At a glance

Compare on the numbers

Indicative secondary-market asking prices and gross yields, compiled from public listings. Yields are gross of management fees, heating and vacancy, which together remove roughly a third.

CityRegionMedian askingGross yieldBest suited to
Shanghai
上海		 East China ¥70k–140k/m² 1.4%–1.9% Buyers who need depth of choice, professional infrastructure and liquidity on exit.
Beijing
北京		 North China ¥60k–120k/m² 1.5%–2.0% Families anchored to education and institutions, and buyers who value a deep professional services market.
Shenzhen
深圳		 South China ¥65k–115k/m² 1.4%–1.8% Buyers who want modern stock, a compact foreign community, and proximity to Hong Kong.
Guangzhou
广州		 South China ¥30k–70k/m² 2.0%–2.6% Buyers who want tier-one infrastructure without tier-one pricing, and families who prioritise food and climate.
Hangzhou
杭州		 East China ¥30k–65k/m² 2.0%–2.6% Buyers who want a lower entry price with genuine urban amenities, and remote or hybrid workers.
Suzhou
苏州		 East China ¥22k–45k/m² 2.2%–2.8% Corporate families who want a settled, school-centred environment with Shanghai within commuting reach.
Chengdu
成都		 Southwest China ¥15k–35k/m² 2.6%–3.2% Long-stay buyers who prioritise lifestyle and cost over liquidity, and remote workers.
Nanjing
南京		 East China ¥26k–50k/m² 2.2%–2.8% Families who want strong education at tier-two prices and can accept a smaller service market.
Tianjin
天津		 North China ¥15k–32k/m² 2.6%–3.2% Buyers with Beijing ties who want space and value, and corporate staff on Binhai assignments.
Qingdao
青岛		 East China ¥18k–40k/m² 2.4%–3.0% Second-home buyers and retirees who want sea air with urban amenities.
Xiamen
厦门		 Southeast China ¥35k–62k/m² 1.8%–2.4% Buyers with regional family ties who want a mild-climate island base.
Wuhan
武汉		 Central China ¥14k–28k/m² 2.8%–3.4% Buyers with an academic or industrial posting who need affordability above all.

Ranges, not appraisals. Check the specific unit against recent registered transactions in the same building before you use any number here in a negotiation.

A city is not a market. It is a set of rules, a set of commutes, and a set of people who will one day buy from you.
